title: Pose, Gesture, Expression, Rig, Anchor, IK & Retarget Preview
objective: Implement topology-aware pose, gesture and expression presentation authoring integrated with owner-supplied/local rig, anchor, IK and retarget preview helpers, reporting incompatibilities explicitly while leaving runtime pose/action/state authority external.

scope.purpose: Extend the MCCS presentation stack into topology-aware pose/expression preview over PAPT/PCA/local rig/anchor/IK/retarget helpers without becoming runtime action, pose, placement or live-state authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative humanoid and nonhumanoid topologies can author and preview deterministic pose/gesture/expression plans using explicit rig/anchor/IK/retarget compatibility references, with incompatibilities unresolved rather than fabricated and without mutating runtime pose/action/placement/live state.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01, MCCS-03, MCCS-05, MCCS-06 and MCCS-09 are completed_verified foundations and are not reopened.
Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-09-triggered rotation or interstitial override; reduced MCCS strict order therefore selects MCCS-11.
Animation/Scene/Combat/Dialogue owners retain runtime action, pose and placement authority; MCCS-11 is preview/authoring only.
PAPT/PCA and lawful local rigging helpers retain generic rig, motion, anchor, IK and retarget primitives; MCCS-11 consumes compatibility/projection references.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form/PPIA retain canonical anatomy/topology/mechanics; CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority.
Unsupported or incompatible topology/rig/anchor/IK/retarget mappings remain explicit and may not be silently coerced to humanoid behavior.
MCCS-11 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
ui-implementation and player-species remain independently governed and must be preserved exactly from fresh CURRENT.
next_action: MCCS-11 is closed. Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-11-triggered rotation or interstitial override, so reduced MCCS strict order selects MCCS-13 — Multi-Profile Derivative Rendering — as selected_not_started.
